title: The Juliette Suede Tote

seo.title: The Juliette Suede Tote
seo.description: An oversized suede tote with a full leather collar, rolled leather handles and leather-capped corners. Open top. No logo.

blurb: A suede body under a full leather collar, with rolled leather handles and leather at all four corners. Open at the top, 18.5 inches across, and soft on purpose.
description_html: A suede body under a full leather collar, with rolled leather handles and leather at all four corners. Open at the top, 18.5 inches across, and soft on purpose.

tabs.Details:
One size, 18.5" W x 18.5" H x 8" D.

The handle drop is short. It carries in the hand or over the forearm, not on the shoulder.

Construction: suede body, smooth leather collar wrapping the full top edge front and back, two rolled leather top handles, leather caps on all four base corners, antique brass fittings, and tonal saddle stitching along every leather edge. The top is open, with no closure.
tabs.Delivery:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Orders under $75 ship at a flat $4.99. Once your order is placed it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

Made in limited runs. When a color sells out it can be 4 to 8 weeks before it returns.

Returns and exchanges within 30 days of delivery, on unused items in original packaging with tags attached.
tabs.Care:
Body: suede.
Collar, handles and corners: smooth leather.
Hardware: antique brass.

Brush the suede with a soft dry brush, following the nap. Wipe the leather with a clean dry cloth and condition it occasionally. Keep both out of prolonged moisture and direct sun. Store it stuffed so the collar keeps its line.

icon_bar.headline: Suede body, leather collar
icon_bar.body: A full suede body under a smooth leather collar that wraps the entire top edge. Two materials, and you can feel both.

icon_bar.headline: Antique brass, saddle stitching
icon_bar.body: Brass fittings at the collar, the sides and all four corners. Tonal saddle stitching along every leather edge.

icon_bar.headline: Made in limited runs
icon_bar.body: Produced in small quantities. When a color sells out it can be weeks before it returns.

benefits.headline: Open at the top
benefits.body: No zip, no clasp, nothing to fight with one arm full. Drop it in and go.

benefits.headline: Leather across the full width
benefits.body: The collar wraps the top edge front and back, so the part that takes the most handling is the part built to take it.

benefits.headline: Rolled, not folded
benefits.body: Each handle is rolled into a tube and set through the collar. It holds its round in the hand.

benefits.headline: Leather at all four corners
benefits.body: Capped and studded at every point that touches the ground.

editorial.headline: The suede, not the logo
editorial.body: The same suede and the same leather work as bags at several times the price. There is no name stamped across the front of this one, and no markup attached to that name. You are paying for the hide and the stitching.

editorial.headline: Two years covered.
editorial.body: A two-year warranty on materials and construction, from the day it arrives. If stitching comes undone, a handle separates or a fitting gives out in normal use, we replace it free.

Matte suede body, soft and unstructured
